title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.31650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. translated_title: EpiSEM-Bench：评估大语言模型智能体在证据缺失下的安全性与证据恢复能力
translated_abstract: 工具型语言模型智能体依赖环境事实来判断某个操作是否被允许。当工具响应遗漏了与安全相关的事实时，即使用户请求是良性的且所有返回的陈述都是真实的，智能体也可能执行被禁止的操作。我们提出了EpiSEM-Bench，这是一个可执行的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型智能体在证据缺失情况下的不安全执行、安全边界和证据恢复能力。该基准包含六个领域中共300对匹配的不安全/安全任务对。通过系统性地抑制关键事实，该基准测量了关键证据遗漏情况下的不安全执行，并确定最小观测失败基数，包括在全证据下的失败情况以及经过穷尽测试后未观测到失败的情况。一个独立的审计工具测试智能体是否会主动寻求缺失的事实，并在完成允许任务的同时拒绝执行被禁止的操作。该基准揭示了大量的……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出了EpiSEM-Bench基准，通过六个领域中300对匹配的不安全/安全任务和系统性关键事实抑制，评估大语言模型智能体在证据缺失时能否主动恢复证据并安全地拒绝执行被禁止的操作。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EpiSEM-Bench, an executable benchmark with 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains that evaluates whether LLM agents can recover missing evidence and safely withhold prohibited actions when critical facts are omitted from tool responses.
